question: I was thinking about it, but if a Great Rabbit was introduced into an area with a Black Snake, wouldn’t one side collapse the other? Do the mabeasts have some sort of territorial thing so they won’t intrude, or something like that? Or are they just accidentally in a position that they don’t interact with each other?
answer: If that happened, it’s probably the Great Rabbit that would be wiped out. In terms of their power relationship, it’s Black Snake > White Whale > Great Rabbit, after all. It’s not so much that they don’t interact, as that the Black Snake isn’t very active. I think you’ll understand when the Black Snake makes an appearance.
